title: Asian chipmakers extend Wall Street losses as US Fed rate hike fears and AI funding worries mount; SK Hynix fell 10%+ on the KRX, while Samsung fell ~10% (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Asian chipmakers extend Wall Street losses as US Fed rate hike fears and AI funding worries mount; SK Hynix fell 10%+ on the KRX, while Samsung fell ~10% — A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday, with Asian and European chipmakers tracking Wall Street losses …
